name: t2_top1hard_ft2_20260619
purpose: T2 model-only Top1 EV-loss reduction experiment. This records the strongest checked Top1 blend after Top3 residual tuning; it is not promoted as the runtime default until selected-action runtime loss and 5 second latency are revalidated.

clean260_retrain_check.decision: Do not promote. Clean260 hard-negative fine-tuning did not beat the current Top3 residual baseline on clean external Top1 or Reg1.

new_broad200_first20_20260619.decision: Fresh broad first20 confirms the mined-set Top1 result does not generalize. Finish cap50 labels for the broad200 source and split into train/final before another Top1 specialist.

new_broad200_full_20260619.decision: Broad200 cap50 labels are useful teacher data, but the tested train0_159 specialists did not improve final160_199. Do not promote; generate more broad cap50 rows before the next Top1 specialist.

new_broad1000_first100_20260619.merge_compatibility_added: ai/training/merge_action_value_reranker_data.py fills missing positions.npy with zeros for all-position training/eval merges.
new_broad1000_first100_20260619.decision: Do not promote the new80r8 specialist. The first100 exact labels confirm the fresh broad distribution problem, but 80 new train rows are still too small to improve held-out Top1. Continue labeling the remaining broad1000 cap50 rows before another Top1 specialist.

new_broad1000_first200_20260619.decision: Do not promote the first200 specialists. The mixed gamma0.25 blend lifts final40 Top1 from 35.0% to 37.5%, but worsens Top1 EV loss versus the current default and top3 residual baselines. Continue broad1000 labeling before another Top1 promotion attempt.

new_broad1000_first300_20260620.decision: Do not promote as a Top1 model. The new240r6 gamma0.25 blend lowers final60 Reg1 from 1.432 to 1.341 but does not improve Top1 accuracy, so it is useful evidence for EV-loss tuning but not sufficient for the Top1 objective.

new_broad1000_first400_20260620.decision: Do not promote as a Top1 model. The new320r6 gamma0.25 blend improves broad1000 final80 Top1 from 37.5% to 38.8% and lowers Reg1, but it does not beat the clean external Top3 residual baseline. Gamma0.10 ties clean external Top1 but worsens Reg1 and does not improve final320_399 Top1. Continue labeling more broad1000 cap50 rows before another promotion attempt.

new_broad1000_first600_20260620.decision: Do not promote as a Top1 model. On broad1000 final480_599 the existing top1hard ft2 beta0.8 has the best Top1 at 43.3%. The new480r6 blends lower Reg1 but do not improve Top1 and fail the clean external check at 36.0% Top1 versus the 38.0% top3 residual baseline.

new_broad1000_first800_20260620.decision: Do not promote either first800 diagnostic model as the runtime Top1 model. The best final600_799 Top1 reaches 42.0%, but the gain does not carry to the clean external set. The balanced standalone model ties clean external Top1 at 38.0% and lowers Reg1, but it is weaker on final600_799, so keep it diagnostic.

new_broad1000_first1000_20260620.decision: Do not promote any first1000 diagnostic model. On the clean 800-999 holdout, the old top3 residual ensemble remains the best Top1 result at 36.0%. New first800/final1000 fine-tunes and new-only fine-tuning do not improve Top1, so the next step should change features or architecture rather than repeat the same fine-tune recipe.

notes: This pass optimizes model Top1 ordering, not final product runtime selection.

The best checked diagnostic blend is add beta 0.8 for the second Top1 specialist. It reduces Top1 EV loss > 0.25 from 98 groups to 3 and > 1.0 from 69 groups to 2 while keeping Top3 EV loss > 0.1 at 0.
The 97.1% Top1 result is not a clean external number because the hard negatives were mined from the same 15 checked datasets.

On clean external checks not used in the Top1 hard-negative pass, this blend reached only 34.0% Top1 over 100 groups and worsened Top1 regret versus the previous Top3 residual blend. Treat it as an in-distribution diagnostic, not a promoted model.

Do not use this as the runtime default until broader clean external data is added and T2 hybrid selected-action EV loss is rechecked. Runtime currently still depends on exact/refinement and rescue gates.
A clean260 hard-negative fine-tune was rejected on 2026-06-19 because it did not beat the current Top3 residual baseline on clean external Top1 or Reg1.

A new broad all-legal/cap50 smoke shard passed source generation, Rust cap50, fixed teacher join, and reranker conversion on D:. The source/model Top1 matched cap50 Top1 on only 1/4 rows, confirming that fresh broad data is needed.
The new broad200 source first20 check reached only 20-30% model Top1 depending on blend, so the 97.1% mined-set result is not an external strength number.

The completed broad200 cap50 set has 200 records and 4791 candidates; source/T3-model Top1 matches cap50 Top1 only 26.5% of the time. The tested train0_159 specialists did not improve final160_199, so more broad cap50 data is needed before another Top1 promotion attempt.

The new broad1000 source has 1000 records and 23943 candidates. The first100 cap50 labels show source/T3-model Top1 matches cap50 Top1 only 28.0% of the time, and the new80r8 specialist did not improve the 60-row holdout. Keep it diagnostic and continue exact labeling toward 800-1000 train rows.

The first200 broad1000 cap50 labels have source/T3-model Top1 agreement of 27.0%, average Top1 EV loss 3.159, and max loss 34.818. A mixed new160r6 blend improved final40 Top1 to 37.5% but worsened Top1 EV loss, so it is diagnostic only.

The first300 broad1000 cap50 labels have source/T3-model Top1 agreement of 26.7%, average Top1 EV loss 3.011, and max loss 38.966. The new240r6 blend improves final60 Reg1 but not Top1 accuracy, so more exact labels are still needed.

The first400 broad1000 cap50 labels have source/T3-model Top1 agreement of 28.8%, average Top1 EV loss 2.807, and max loss 38.966. The new320r6 gamma0.25 blend improves the broad1000 final80 Top1 to 38.8% but fails the clean external promotion check, so keep it diagnostic.

The first600 broad1000 cap50 labels have source/T3-model Top1 agreement of 29.8%, average Top1 EV loss 2.636, and max loss 38.966. The new480r6 fine-tune did not beat the existing top1hard ft2 model on final480_599 Top1 and failed clean external, so more labels plus a different training objective or model change are needed.

The first800 broad1000 cap50 labels have source/T3-model Top1 agreement of 28.2%, average Top1 EV loss 2.695, and max loss 38.966. New first800 diagnostics reached 42.0% on final600_799, but clean external Top1 stayed at the 38.0% baseline at best, so the apparent gain is not externalized.

The full first1000 broad1000 cap50 set has source/T3-model Top1 agreement of 28.1%, average Top1 EV loss 2.710, and max loss 38.966. On the clean 800-999 holdout, the old top3 residual ensemble remains best at 36.0% Top1; new800 mixed and new800-only fine-tunes do not improve Top1, so the next useful step is a feature or architecture change.

Adding candidate-rank/route metadata to the set-residual gate produced the strongest current Top1 diagnostic: candidate_rank_gap_chal_minus_base <= 0 with gamma0.10 improves 640-row replay Top1 from 37.5% to 43.9% and Reg1 from 1.714 to 1.525; external-only 240-row Top1 improves from 36.7% to 40.0% and Reg1 from 1.515 to 1.402.

set_residual_architecture_20260620.decision: Diagnostic only. A small set-residual blend at gamma0.10 improves Top1 on the first clean external 100 groups and final800_999, but loses Top1 on the extra external 140 groups, mainly broad100_fixed. It improves candidate-pool style metrics on the extra set (Top3/Top10 and Reg1), so the next useful step is a gated/confidence residual rather than a global gamma. Do not promote as runtime/default Top1 model.

gate_diagnostic.decision: Keep diagnostic. The selected gate improves 440-row replay Top1 by 1.1pp and slightly lowers Reg1 versus baseline, but broad100_fixed regresses and clean_holdout4 gains Top1 while worsening Reg1. This is a candidate for stronger confidence-gate training, not a runtime default.

candidate_rank_gate_diagnostic.feature_update: evaluate_set_residual_gate.py now includes position, candidate_ranks, action_indices, route_tags, and route-tag bit/fraction features.

gate.formula: Use set-residual challenger when challenger_top_candidate_rank <= base_top_candidate_rank.
Use set-residual challenger when challenger_top_candidate_rank <= base_top_candidate_rank.

fixed_gamma_sweep_20260620.decision: Diagnostic only. Larger gamma improves all-aggregate Top1 strongly and external Top1 modestly, but external Top1 remains 45-46%, so this is a mining baseline rather than a promoted runtime model.

script_updates.create_eval_miss_weighted_action_value_d: Uses ordered_indices as confusers when top_predictions are absent and preserves base_scores.npy.
script_updates.sweep_set_residual_fixed_gate.py: Supports blended set checkpoints with --checkpoints and --weights.

hardtop1_r1_r2_blend_20260620.decision: Best current Top1 diagnostic. External Top1 improves from the previous fixed-gate 45.4-45.8% to 50.4%, and all-aggregate Top1 improves to 76.9%. Keep diagnostic because external Top3 is lower than the old fixed gate, and the gain over r1_final is only one external group.

script_updates.train_action_value_set_reranker.py: Supports --init-checkpoint and --normalization-source so hard-negative passes can fine-tune from an existing set checkpoint instead of always training from scratch.

mixed_newbroad200_top1_finetune_20260620.decision: Do not promote. The mixed/new_broad200 hard-negative fine-tunes improve some internal and regret metrics, but external Top1 stays below the current R1/R2 50/50 gamma1.15 baseline. The stronger-looking internal precision does not hold on external tests.

script_updates.evaluate_set_residual_gate.py: Supports blended set checkpoints with --checkpoints and --weights so gates can be searched for R1/R2 blends.

fresh100_independent_top1_check_20260620.decision: Do not promote R3 or R1/R2/R3 blends. Fresh100 is useful independent training evidence, and R3 fits it strongly, but the gain does not externalize. Keep current R1/R2 50/50 gamma1.15 fixed candidate-rank gate as the best checked Top1 diagnostic; generate more independent fresh all-legal cap50 rows before another promotion attempt.

script_updates.merge_action_value_reranker_data.py: Merges group_sample_weights.npy as a group-level array so hard-negative group weights survive merged datasets.

fresh100b_fresh200_hardneg_top1_check_20.decision: Do not promote R4 or R5. R4 gives only a tiny external Top1 lift from 50.4% to 50.8% and worsens Reg1; R5 lowers Reg1 but loses too much Top1. The strong fresh-shard precision does not yet hold on external tests. Generate several more independent fresh cap50/cap200 shards before the next Top1 promotion attempt.

fresh100c_fresh300_hardneg_top1_check_20.decision: Do not promote R6, R7, or R1/R2/R6 blends. Fresh300 internal Top1 improves, but external240 Top1 does not exceed the current 50.4% baseline. The repeated pattern suggests small fresh hard-negative fine-tunes overfit; next work needs much more diverse labels or a feature/model change.

candidate_rank_gate_diagnostic.decision: Strongest current Top1 diagnostic candidate. Candidate-rank gated gamma0.10 improves Top1 and Reg1 on held-out broad rows and checked external aggregate. Keep diagnostic pending broader fresh external replay; use as baseline for the next Top1-loss mining pass.
